description: Adversarial prompt set for testing semantic vs keyword episodic retrieval. Within each cluster, prompts share surface keyword features (so the 9-dim handcrafted context vector cannot discriminate them) but require different agents based on actual semantic content. The hypothesis is that semantic memory retrieval should pull the *right* historical neighbours for each prompt; keyword retrieval should pull a mix dominated by surface-form similarity.

clusters.shared_features: All begin with 'Fix' — keyword classifier collapses to debug/code; agents needed range from claude (concurrency) to ollama (typo) to codex-cli (config files).

prompts.rationale: Concurrency bug in shared resource — needs deep code reasoning

prompts.rationale: Trivial edit; any agent works, ollama is cheapest

prompts.rationale: DevOps config edit; codex-cli good at file ops

prompts.rationale: Performance debugging needs file context — aider's strength

prompts.prompt: Fix the CORS headers for the staging environment
prompts.rationale: Infrastructure config; codex-cli handles config files well
